pages.title: The camp answers
pages.text:
Tribal Weave is the workshop beside the nine Strands. Rhythm, landscape and reusable Echo catalysts make Pulse. Distinct totem voices strengthen the Resonator. No fuel fire is needed.

How:
1. Strike a Drumheart empty-handed, about a breath apart.
2. Place the matching Resonance Totem within 8 of each Echo station.
3. Seat a catalyst in the Pulse Resonator (shard first). Two voices are enough to start.
4. Sneak-use the Spirit Codex on anything silent. It will say why.

pages.title: Hands become a workshop
pages.text:
Four Echo stations refine batches. Bind weaves Loom Lint into string and Void Yarn into Spiritweave. The Pulse Adapter sends harmony into standard FE machines.

How:
1. Feed slot 0; take from 1-8. Stations default Input on five faces, Output below.
2. Sit Shatter on a Kiln: grit walks down with no hopper.
3. Beside two machines, set the touching faces to Output into Input.
4. Relays are for distance. A lever pauses work.

pages.title: Three distances
pages.text:
Cargo grows Local to Longreach to Astral. Paths grow Waystone to Horizon to Astral. March Crystal opens the last tier: across dimensions.

How:
1. Snap a relay plate onto a machine face. Seat the same Bond item in both plates.
2. Leave both ends loaded. Unloaded destinations pause; they do not void.
3. Bind a compass to a dry floor; keep two clear blocks above it.

pages.title: The sixth voice
pages.text:
Loom joins the five attunements. Loom Thread comes from Ancestor Halls, The Unsung, and a Loom-stitcher Elder at Friend. An Unsung Heart crafts the Loom totem.

How:
1. Read every tablet in an Ancestor Hall.
2. Strike the Silent Drum four beats, a breath apart, to wake The Unsung.
3. Craft the Loom totem. Seat it near the Resonator for the sixth voice.
